name: code-quality-mentor
description: Turn code-quality findings into a personalized learning plan. The /code-quality-mentor:scan command runs PMD plus a catalog-driven LLM antipattern scan across a Git repository, attributes each finding to its author via git blame, lets you pick one developer, and synthesizes a focused LEARNING_PLAN.md that leads with the underlying design principle and uses the author's actual flagged code as evidence.
